theorem_title: Constructing a rectangular table of band-candidate records
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBandCandidatesTable.meets {pMain pRow pCell : ℕ} (mode : _root_.ThreeSum.BandCandidateRows.Mode)
    (hmain : P[pMain]?=some (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBandCandidatesTable.body pRow))
    (hrow : P[pRow]?=some (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBandCandidatesRow.body pCell))
    (hcell : P[pCell]?=some (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBandCandidatesCell.body mode))
    (hw : (lim.space : ℤ) ≤ lim.word) (hd : d+1 < lim.depth)
    (hsrc : src+m*n ≤ dst) (hspace : dst+4*(m*n) ≤ lim.space)
    (hword : ((U+10 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ lim.word) (hm : m ≤ U) (hn : n ≤ U)
    (hf : ∀ i < m, ∀ j < n, f i j ≤ U)
    (hread : ∀ i < m, ∀ j < n, μ (src+i*n+j)=(f i j : ℤ)) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Meets lim P pMain d [src,dst,m,n] μ (_root_.ThreeSum.LightBandCandidatesTable.time m n)
      (fun _ ν =>
        (∀ i < m, ∀ j < n, _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Seg ν (dst+4*(i*n+j)) (_root_.ThreeSum.BandCandidateRows.make mode i j (f i j)).cells) ∧
        _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.SameOutside μ ν dst (4*(m*n))) := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
Let a stored natural matrix $f(i,j)$ have dimensions $m,n$, with dimensions and entries at most $U$. Suppose the mode-specific table, row, and cell procedures are installed, source precedes destination, $4mn$ output cells fit, $U+10$ and addresses fit words, and the call depth is available. The table program writes every four-cell record $\operatorname{make}(\mathrm{mode},i,j,f(i,j))$ at row-major offset $4(in+j)$ within its stated time, changing only the output table.

This table contract constructs all physical candidate records from the stored rectangular owner data.
